as_told.title: Special forces source sees a blacker-than-black hovering sphere overseas

plain: A soldier is said to have been brought into a room and shown a floating sphere "blacker than black" that gave off "a sense of just complete evil and darkness." A congressman named Eric Burlison tells this on the show, passing on what the man himself told him. In Burlison's telling the man served in special forces and saw the hovering black sphere while in the field overseas during the wars; if true, it would mean soldiers have met something that felt actively hostile.
